 Learn more Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian chats with Brooke DiPalma and Jake Conley about why Anthropic ( ANT ) stock is losing momentum on day one of trading. 
 Video Transcript 00:00 Speaker A shares opened at 11 111.50. Uh that was the first market debut. Uh shares were up a little bit, popped a little bit, and then they sort of like I said, down draft down, trickle down here. 
 00:10 Speaker A Uh hit a low of I think what was it 92, 92 72. And now we're at 96 29. I want to bring in Rick De Palma and Jay Conley, my co-host for the 8:30. 
 00:20 Speaker A Uh what's going on here exactly? I'm not exactly sure. 
 00:26 Jay Conley I think that we saw less retail investor appetite than maybe we saw with SpaceX. Following the SpaceX IPO, we saw a huge run up. Even the following day, I believe we also saw that same excitement, that same moment. 
 00:36 Jay Conley I think with this one, it's a little bit different. Like you just said, this is the first pure play uh IPO within the US that is and uh and there's a lot of skepticism. 
 00:46 Jay Conley What exactly does AI mean moving forward? What exactly kind of numbers will this company put out in the coming months? I think SpaceX there was a lot of just excitement about the reality of some of the things Elon Musk really ramped up coming to fruition. 
 00:54 Rick De Palma No, this is this is exactly right. What Anthropic didn't have that SpaceX did was Elon, was a a person that people look at as a prophet 
 01:02 Rick De Palma and that retail investors really like to leg on to and kind of follow whatever he says and believe in the vision. Dario's never been that inspirational public speaker. 
 01:08 Rick De Palma Jamie Diamond did a little bit ahead of the listing to help with the retail allocations and get people excited. But still, we knew the stock was going to be volatile on day one. IPO stocks usually are. 
 01:17 Rick De Palma The question for me is what does this look like a week down the road, a month down the road, a year down the road? Because as Brooke points out, it's the first pure play generative AI lab in the US. We don't know how to value this thing yet. We don't know how the street's going to treat it. 
 01:28 Speaker A So, as of right now, we're up 15% from the IPO price last night. 
 01:33 Jay Conley $83. $83. 
 01:34 Speaker A Yeah, 15% move right now, so it looks good. But at the same time, we opened at 11 111.50. 
 01:40 Speaker A Yeah. And what it sort of indicates to me is that maybe there's some insider selling here. Uh maybe the demand is isn't as strong as, you know, the initial buying was when before the this stock went public at the market debut price. 
 01:47 Jay Conley Vanda research actually putting out a note this afternoon, certainly saying here that net buying was good initially, they said that looking comparing it to the SpaceX playbook, um they're on track right now for anywhere between 80 to 90 million dollars uh in terms of net retail net buying today. But that was placed behind SpaceX which raised 118 million, behind Coinbase which brought in about 92 million in retail net buying. 
 02:03 Jay Conley So that that definitely would be interesting as well to see. Also keep in mind, there's certain criteria, especially for retail traders to to get in on the stock. 
 02:07 Rick De Palma It's also you look at uh to take those two examples, SpaceX and Coinbase, both of those companies were companies that retail investors really glammed onto, really got excited about. 
 02:16 Rick De Palma But look at what's happened with Anthropic over the last two or three months. They came out saying, we want $2 trillion dollars. Then that was kicked down to a trillion. Then it was kicked back up to 1.4, then back down. 
 02:25 Rick De Palma Today, they did get their two trillion. They didn't end up having to take the haircut, but there was some consternation to get there and does that maybe speak to the idea that even though retail got a 15% slice of this IPO, maybe the excitement was replaced by a little bit of skepticism, by a little bit of wait and see what happens because again, we don't know how to value a stock like this.
